text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
There is no doubt she put in all the effort she could
and gave it everything she had.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...However, my light is still
far too faint..."
choice_data_list: Let's think of a way to win together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. In that case, I will gladly
take you up on your offer and borrow your wisdom.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I will brace myself and do my best once more,
so I look forward to working with you going forward.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
!! ...Yes, it is just as you say.
I gave it my all, but I still fell short of the others.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Maybe my training was lacking,
but I don't want to use my weak body as an excuse.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"I will devote myself to winning next time,
so please continue to support me going forward."
